glosses: to flip one's clothes inside out
to scroll (e.g. a webpage or document)
to be rewound on another spool
to pass over, to pass through (to be somewhere for some time)
to get through something by passing obstacles
to appear in a zigzag line
to appear in something from time to time

Oj tą siwą gąsecką
